objectives.objective: Look for opportunities in cybersecurity services for small businesses
objectives.constraints: Argentina; services or intelligence businesses; no venture-scale assumptions

must_cite: a domestic buyer or regulator source
a competitor price or offer
red_flags: overseas BPO staffed in Argentina presented as domestic demand
market size from a vendor report as the only demand evidence

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities supplying inputs, spare parts or maintenance to small and mid-sized agricultural producers
objectives.constraints: Argentina, Pampas and NOA regions; physical goods or field services; working capital under USD 50,000

must_cite: a producer association, INTA or ministry source on the need
a current distributor price list or dealer offer
red_flags: large-estate agribusiness evidence presented as small-producer demand
import prices quoted without current exchange-rate or duty treatment

objectives.objective: Look for software opportunities for independent accountants who serve monotributo taxpayers
objectives.constraints: Argentina; software sold to accounting practices; must work with ARCA (former AFIP) filing obligations

must_cite: an ARCA/AFIP rule or calendar that creates the recurring work
an existing tool's published price or feature list
red_flags: demand inferred only from the number of registered taxpayers
a global accounting SaaS presented as unavailable when it already serves Argentina

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities in small-batch packaged food manufacturing for regional supermarket chains
objectives.constraints: Mexico, Bajío region; manufacturing or co-packing; must satisfy NOM-051 labelling

must_cite: a retailer supplier requirement or category listing
a co-packer or competing product price
red_flags: national chain demand presented as regional chain demand
unit economics that ignore NOM-051 relabelling or shelf fees

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities helping small Mexican exporters meet United States import compliance requirements
objectives.constraints: Mexico; services or intelligence for exporters under 100 employees; USMCA context

must_cite: a US agency or USMCA rule that exporters must meet
a customs broker or consultant fee
red_flags: maquiladora or large-exporter evidence used for small exporters
a rule change cited without its effective date

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities providing outsourced back-office services to private dental and medical clinics
objectives.constraints: Brazil, São Paulo and Minas Gerais; services; must respect LGPD health-data rules

must_cite: a clinic association, ANS or CFM/CFO source on the workload
a competing service provider's price or package
red_flags: hospital-scale revenue-cycle evidence presented as small-clinic demand
a plan that handles health data without addressing LGPD

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities in maintaining rooftop solar systems and refurbishing their components
objectives.constraints: Brazil, Northeast; field services or component refurbishment; no utility-scale projects

must_cite: an ANEEL or ABSOLAR figure on installed distributed generation
a maintenance or inverter-repair price
red_flags: installation growth presented as maintenance demand without a failure or warranty basis
utility-scale O&M contracts used as price evidence

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities matching spare machining and fabrication capacity among small manufacturers
objectives.constraints: Germany, Mittelstand suppliers under 250 employees; brokerage, intelligence or services; no marketplace that requires network effects to start

must_cite: an industry association, IHK or Destatis source on utilisation
an existing capacity platform's fee or terms
red_flags: a two-sided marketplace with no plan for the first transactions
automotive-OEM evidence presented as Mittelstand demand

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities supplying, refurbishing or servicing equipment for independent bakeries
objectives.constraints: France; physical goods or field services; independent artisan bakeries, not industrial chains

must_cite: a CNBPF, INSEE or chamber-of-trades source on independent bakeries
a new or refurbished equipment price or service contract
red_flags: industrial bakery chain evidence presented as artisan demand
refurbishment margins assumed without parts or labour cost evidence

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities providing demand and pricing intelligence to rural tourism lodging operators
objectives.constraints: Spain, interior provinces; intelligence or software; operators with fewer than 20 rooms

must_cite: an INE or regional tourism statistic on rural lodging
a revenue-management or channel-manager price
red_flags: urban hotel revenue-management evidence presented as rural demand
OTA listing counts used as willingness to pay

objectives.objective: Look for software opportunities for small home-care agencies
objectives.constraints: United States; software for agencies with under 50 caregivers; must account for EVV mandates

must_cite: a CMS, state Medicaid or EVV rule that drives the workflow
an incumbent tool's published price
red_flags: enterprise home-health platform evidence presented as small-agency demand
ignoring that state EVV aggregators are free to agencies

objectives.objective: Look for opportunities providing quality inspection and compliance services to small textile exporters
objectives.constraints: India, Tiruppur and Surat clusters; services or intelligence; buyers in the EU and US

must_cite: a buyer, export council or regulation that requires the inspection or certification
a third-party inspection agency's fee
red_flags: large-exporter or brand-audit evidence presented as small-exporter demand
an EU rule cited without whether it applies to the exporter's product
